title: Once her in townhithe meeting he to her bow had not doffed.
html_source:
That is to say that Bloom had not been chivalrous to Nurse Callan during a previous encounter.

It furthers the outsider theme initiated by the description of him as a wandering Jew – Of Israel’s folk was that man that on earth wandering far had fared.

‘Virgin and Veteran Readings of Ulysses’
By Margot Norris, p142.

hithe = haven in Anglo-Saxon (Gifford,410).
